title: Safco Vista Drafting Table
body_html:
A tool-free drawing table that adjusts to the way you work.

The Safco Vista pairs a lightweight, durable tubular-steel frame with a full-width footrest for all-day comfort. Easy-access knobs adjust working height from 30″ to 46″ and tilt the surface up to 45° — no tools required — so the table fits the task instead of the other way around.

Key features

  • Height adjusts 30″–46″ without tools
  • Worksurface tilts up to 45°
  • Full-width footrest for comfort
  • Easy-access adjustment knobs
  • Lightweight, durable tubular steel frame

Who it’s for

Studios, classrooms, and drafting rooms needing an affordable, tool-free adjustable drawing table.

Office Central and Brant Business Interiors are verified OECM partners, so Ontario’s public sector can buy without an open tender. Call 1-800-835-9565 for a quote.
